_readme: DEMO SEED. All coordinates, parameters and counts are PLACEHOLDERS near Old Rajinder Nagar / Karol Bagh. Replace with field data and set data_source='field'. Ownership rows cite a source or say none.

assets.name: Patel Road barrel (1976 plan), East Patel Nagar
assets.owner_source: PWD road inventory RD-00798 'Patel Road' (West Road Division 2), Right of Way 36.57 m, 60 ft or more. GNCTD notification 10.01.2012 vests roads of 60 ft or more with PWD (PWD reply in NGT OA 559/2022); SDMC affidavit to the NGT, Feb 2020: drains on those roads are PWD's (South Delhi statement, applied here by inference)
assets.citation: OpenStreetMap way/28190350 (road line, ODbL, retrieved 2026-10-10); PWD road inventory RD-00798 'Patel Road' (West Road Division 2), Right of Way 36.57 m, 60 ft or more; I&FC Master Plan for drainage of the MCD and DDA area (1976), Karol Bagh Zone
assets.note: Alignment: the barrel runs along Patel Road for 2,000 m from the Pusa Road and Shankar Road crossing. Older source conflict: the 1976 plan lists it among MCD drains.

assets.name: Daryai Nallah barrel, Pusa Road crossing (inferred)
assets.owner_source: 1976 master plan lists Daryai Nallah among the MCD drains of Karol Bagh Zone. MCD Commissioner told the High Court on 2 Aug 2024 the Old Rajinder Nagar storm drain is dysfunctional. That this section is Daryai Nallah is inferred from the route (see checks)
assets.citation: OpenStreetMap way/1378604253 (road line, ODbL, retrieved 2026-10-10); 1976 master plan lists Daryai Nallah among the MCD drains of Karol Bagh Zone; I&FC Master Plan for drainage of the MCD and DDA area (1976), Karol Bagh Zone
assets.note: Position: north end of Bazaar Marg where it meets Pusa Road, about 800 m of route from the Shankar Road origin in the 1976 text. Context asset, not linked to the pocket: a pocket's drainage is limited by its worst linked drain, so linking two would make cleaning either one worth nothing in the simulator.

pockets.name: Pusa Road at Karol Bagh Metro Station
pockets.note: Waterlogging place named in the FCO (Pusa Road, Karol Bagh Metro Station). Position about 30 m (grade A, 2 independent source phrases). Waterlogging recorded on 2 dates (by year, 2023: 1, 2024: 1); 0 on days when 3 or fewer places were listed citywide. Drain capacity 17.6 mm/h is the 1976 design unit discharge of 0.7 cusec per acre; catchment, runoff coefficient and storage are scenario defaults for the kind, not measured. Exposed assets = OSM schools, clinics, hospitals and libraries within 200 m of the position.
pockets.citation: Flood Control Order 2025, Dept of Revenue GNCTD (ifc.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/ifc/universal/fco_2025.pdf), Delhi Traffic Police waterlogging lists: rows 2023 #164, PDF pages 73. I&FC Flood Control Wing, Master Plan for storm water drainage of the MCD and DDA area (1976), Karol Bagh Zone. position from OpenStreetMap features named in the source text (ODbL)
